Obtaining

[edit | edit source]

A Bread Bowl can be purchased from Feast Baker Scott for 10,000 Kernels.

Usage

[edit | edit source]

A Bread Bowl can be given to another player. Upon doing so, the Bread Bowl is consumed and the receiving player receives a  Gifted Bread Bowl.

Upon gifting a Bread Bowl, the following message is displayed:

---------------------------------------
<player> RECEIVED A BREAD BOWL FROM <player>
 
GG!
---------------------------------------
